description: Explicitly authorized xUnit skips for the solution-wide .NET test gate (scripts/ci/assert_test_totals.py, used by ci.yml and scripts/dev/test.ps1 -Level 3). A skip is accepted only when the project, the exact TRX test name and the exact skip reason all match one entry; any other skipped, aborted or not-executed test fails the gate. Every entry is an opt-in integration test that never runs on hosted CI runners: (1) real-Vault integration tests (E-2, E-3 M2c, E-4, E-5), which run only when their developer script provisions a disposable Vault Transit container and exports the variables; (2) SEC-BL-01 environment-dependent real-store integration tests, which run only when scripts/dev/sec-bl-01-wp4-pg-azurite-gate.ps1 or scripts/dev/sec-bl-01-wp2-azurite-integration.ps1 provisions disposable PostgreSQL and Azurite stores and exports the SECBL01_* variables; and (3) the SEC-BL-01 OBS-1 timing characterization tests, which run only with SECBL01_OBS1_CHARACTERIZE=1. An authorized skip records no pass: these tests remain subject to on-demand verification and to the applicable release acceptance requirements (ADR-PB-003, PB-12). Adding an entry requires review; a stale entry (test no longer in the results) fails the gate.
